facts.fact: 全屋白天从 Rookery 搬进 Museum，Museum 原有住户提前腾出一间展厅，一次搬运就搬完
facts.anchor: The day was spent moving to the Museum.

facts.fact: Tris 在 Museum 看见百人排队领饭、另有百人在吃，判断无派系者人数远超她原先设想
facts.anchor: there are a hundred people in line for food, another hundred eating it

facts.fact: Mender 与妹妹 Mae 命运的监护听证就在明天，早上他背袋子去新住处时手在抖
facts.anchor: The hearing that will determine his fate—and his sister’s fate—is tomorrow.

facts.fact: 母亲说监护听证按惯例在 Abnegation 总部举行，但 Candor 与 Erudite 近来要求改在自己总部
facts.anchor: Custody hearings take place at Abnegation headquarters as a matter of course

facts.fact: 母亲为最近施加的「沉默处罚」道歉，说那是为了让她闭嘴以求保护
facts.anchor: I recently imposed the Penalty of Silence on you

facts.fact: 母亲答应让父亲在听证后的评议阶段去找 Candor 代表 Jack Kang 谈
facts.anchor: I’ll tell your father to talk to Jack Kang after the hearing, during deliberations

facts.fact: Evelyn 在火车上告诉 Tris，Foxes 的一面旗在摩天轮，算是还她的人情
